adapter_owner: Management owns StatsCampaignAdapter; active statistics annex contains no collection adapter. Only the sibling interface was inspected.
scope: G7-G10; all collection/provenance verification is injected and independently rederived by collection code

protocol.root: path to campaign/output root; writes root/statistics/{analysis,power,calibration}. Power forbids actual units/outcome, units/endpoint, units/outcome-anchors and contacts/outcome plus historical paths; directory absence alone is insufficient.
protocol.repo: path to pinned repository, for receipt provenance only; statistics never imports predecessor analyzers
protocol.entryexit(stage): UNENTERED context manager; statistics creates its exclusive CLAIM first. Validates independently committed complete source/import/read pins at ENTRY AND EXIT, re-enumerates inventories, consumes separately evidenced stage authority, checks all global HALTED markers; raises on failure. Yields {provenance_sha256:SHA256,input_sha256:{logical_name:SHA256},...stage-specific fields below}. No pass boolean. Source closure includes all exp7stats/exp7core modules and package initializers, aliases and transitive executed imports, not just a snapshot.
protocol.battery(): returns battery payload below; immutable by convention, statistics copies to immutable dataclasses and rechecks full coverage
protocol.predictor_data(): returns {schema:'exp7.analysis-predictors.v1',trained:{pythia_1b:{family:[{id,draws:{q0:[str*64],q1:[str*64],q0s:[str*64],q1s:[str*64]}}]},olmo2_1b:{...}},twin:{family:[{id,draws:{four arms each16 strings}}]}}; lists in battery order
protocol.verify_predictor_seal(): rederives complete trained+twin+anchor source/provenance/coverage gates; returns {seal_sha256:SHA256,battery_sha256:SHA256,bindings:{relative_path:SHA256}}; nonempty bindings, no self-pins
protocol.verify_power(): rederives separately committed pre-outcome power record and bindings; returns {power_sha256:SHA256,record:<decoded root/statistics/power/power.json>}; statistics rechecks seal,battery,grid,subsets and declarations; no recalculation of simulations
protocol.verify_complete(): analysis only: rederives complete26 outcome windows, full paired endpoint gates per host, all raw/provenance/anchor/seal/timing constraints; returns {complete_sha256:SHA256,bindings:{relative_path:SHA256}}

battery_payload.levels_sha256: actual tagged base-strata level table SHA256

each_family: all21 certified baseline responder IDs, including N/A cells

each_family.base: stable tagged merged base-stratum ID; metadata-only, no model values

each_certified_baseline_ID.na_reason: null for applicable; nonempty certified reason for N/A
each_certified_baseline_ID.outputs: applicable: exact four-arm string dict; N/A:null
each_certified_baseline_ID.abstained: applicable: exact four-arm bool dict; N/A:null

serialization: statistics internal Fraction values serialize as {numerator:int,denominator:positive_int}; serializer recursively restores these on read; all other fields ordinary JSON; no NaN/Infinity

stage_requirements.calibration: BEFORE prereg tag, projection and predictor seal. Pure CalibrationContext(root,repo,candidate_commit=40hex,manifest_path=repo_relative,manifest_sha256=independently_fixed_SHA). Bind committed candidate code/design/synthetic-case manifest; no Campaign constructor, model backend or model-contact grant. Source package closure and pinned read tracing verified at entry/exit. Output root outside candidate repo. No preregistration tag may exist. Yields synthetic_spec matching calibration.frozen_cases() and candidate_commit. This planning stage does not execute production calibration.
stage_requirements.power: AFTER verified predictor seal and accepted committed calibration, BEFORE ANY outcome contact/probe/load/grant/phase marker. Context requires independently evidenced power authority, prereg/projection pins, verified seal and complete no-outcome contact inventory at entry AND exit. input_sha256 must include code_manifest,source_manifest,calibration,contact_inventory, plus every read/source binding. calibration is hash of root/statistics/calibration/calibration.json; adapter may copy byte-identical accepted pre-tag calibration into that immutable path before power. Power never reads outcomes() or computes actual selectivity p/effect gate.
stage_requirements.analysis: Requires prereg/projection, predictor seal, independently committed complete outcome receipt and pre-outcome power record, all data/host/anchor gates and owner's once-only analyzer word/grant. Context verifies at entry AND exit; actual raw draws are returned only inside context. Statistics consumes exclusive claim before any data reads. No automatic rerun on refusal.

contact_inventory.contract: The yielded contact_inventory contains ONLY schema,covered_roots,entries. Bind its canonical exp7stats.common.dumps SHA as input_sha256.contact_inventory. Adapter inventories ALL actual collection contact/load/claim/grant/probe/phase roots, not just these minimum prefixes; must refuse unrecognized/unclassifiable markers, every outcome-related marker (including unconsumed outcome grant), and any omitted receipt. Exit re-enumerates and compares to ENTRY inventory, not just rehashing the old dict. A claimed empty inventory is not verification. stats rechecks the binding/path absence before final publish.

baseline_rules.missing: Any omitted catalog cell/row/arm or unknown applicability refuses; refusal report names baseline coverage/applicability failure. No missing cell may masquerade as N/A.
baseline_rules.not_applicable: All35 cells retained with certified nonempty reason; output/abstention fields null, no invented raw strings.
baseline_rules.applicable: All49 cells retained. Adapter may map archived deterministic baseline None to empty-string MISS ONLY with abstained[arm]=true and preserved per-pair metadata; non-None raw strings remain unchanged. N/A status/reason fixed across500 pairs in a cell. Never remove applicable abstentions from 49-cell denominator.
baseline_rules.model_outputs: Predictor/twin/outcome raw None ALWAYS refuses, never converts to string or MISS.
baseline_rules.report: S7 includes all84 cells, applicability denominator49, N/A reasons, abstentions by arm and pair, N500 for every applicable cell; S8 rescoring applies to every applicable raw baseline.

collection_mapping.battery: Use certified Battery, base_assignments(), baseline_catalog(), baseline_draws(); preserve exact certified identity/metadata, words->unscrambling already collection-owned. Do not reverse-engineer raw from Score.
collection_mapping.predictors: Use predictor_draws() axes pair/ARMS/draw; predictor_data() scores are only cross-checks; stats rederives from raw.
collection_mapping.outcomes: Use outcome_draws() axes pair/GRID/ARMS; stats rederives all counts. Collection outcomes() alone cannot satisfy raw contract.
collection_mapping.receipts: Use seal_bindings(), power_bindings(), complete_bindings(). verify_complete() returning None is not itself a receipt. Independent committed receipt identity must be preserved.
collection_mapping.source_bindings: input_sha256 keys code_manifest and source_manifest must map actual independently pinned collection manifest values (bindings() publishes names with _sha256 suffix). No made-up expected hashes.
collection_mapping.power_validator: Decode via exp7stats.common.decode then exp7stats.power.verify_power_semantics(record,sealSHA,batterySHA); validator returns verified record, collection wrapper may discard and return None. No simulation is rerun.

production_api: python -B -m exp7stats.calibration_cli --root OUTPUT --repo REPO --candidate-commit COMMIT --manifest PATH --manifest-sha256 SHA
candidate_manifest: schema exp7.calibration-candidate.v1, files:{repo_relative_path:{kind:source|design|synthetic_spec,sha256:SHA}}; exactly one synthetic_spec; include all .py files in both pure packages, all additional imported local helpers/init/CLI modules, design and frozen case JSON. Manifest and all files must match independently fixed committed candidate. Clear candidate project bytecode before cold launch. Candidate commit binding, not prereg tag.
miniature_api: separate synthetic_* functions require explicit miniature settings; no production execution in this authoring session
